rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The party journal reports that 'The Congress president, Mrs. Sonia Gandhi converted the working committee into Steering Committee' in the wake of the organisational elections, and that AICC general secretary Shri Oscar Fernandes said on November 26 that, consequent upon the election of the president and in terms of the party constitution, the Congress president had converted the existing Working Committee into a Steering Committee and asked the office-bearers to continue until a new Working Committee was formed.
